logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _build_embedding_warning_display(failure_count: int, folder: str = None) -> dbc.Alert:
    """Build a warning alert for embedding health check failures."""
    if failure_count <= 0:
        return None
    
    msg_parts = [
        html.Strong(f"⚠️ {failure_count} image(s) skipped embedding: "),
        "Embedding backend health check failed"
    ]
    if folder:
        msg_parts.append(html.Br())
        msg_parts.append(html.Small(f"Folder: {folder}", className="text-muted"))
    
    return dbc.Alert(
        msg_parts,
        color="warning",
        dismissable=True,
        className="mb-2",
    )

def register_batch_callback(app, app_config):
    @app.callback(
        Output("processing-status", "children"),
        Input("btn-process-batch", "n_clicks"),
        State("input-folder", "value"),
        State("chk-recursive", "value"),
        State("input-host", "value"),
        State("input-port", "value"),
        State("input-model", "value"),
        State("input-backend", "value"),
        State("input-timeout", "value"),
        State("chk-dry-run", "value"),
        State("input-batch-size", "value"),
        background=True,
        prevent_initial_call=True,
        running=[
            (Output("btn-process-batch", "disabled"), True, False),
            (Output("btn-process-all", "disabled"), True, False),
            (Output("btn-reprocess", "disabled"), True, False),
        ],
    )
    def queue_all_images(n_clicks, folder, recursive, host, port, model, backend, timeout, dry_run, batch_size):
        if not n_clicks or not folder:
            return dash.no_update

        limit = int(batch_size) if batch_size else 10
        if limit <= 0:
            limit = None

        logger.info("[Batch] received batch_size=%r, computed limit=%s", batch_size, limit)

        source = FolderImageSource(folder, recursive=bool(recursive), exclude_processed=True)
        image_paths = source.list_images(limit=limit)
        if not image_paths:
            return "No new images to process."

        pc = _make_processing_config(host, port, model, backend, timeout, app_config.default_prompt, dry_run=bool(dry_run))
        strategy = _make_wal_strategy(folder, app_config)
        reporter = FileProgressReporter(folder)
        collector = CollectingSidecarSaver()

        batch_coordinator = BatchCoordinator(config=pc, strategy=strategy)
        batch_coordinator.run_folder_batch(
            folder,
            recursive=bool(recursive),
            limit=limit,
            saver=collector,
            reporter=reporter,
        )

        prefix = "Dry-run" if dry_run else "Batch"
        return f"{prefix} complete."


def register_process_all_callback(app, app_config):
    @app.callback(
        Output("processing-status", "children", allow_duplicate=True),
        Input("btn-process-all", "n_clicks"),
        State("input-folder", "value"),
        State("chk-recursive", "value"),
        State("input-host", "value"),
        State("input-port", "value"),
        State("input-model", "value"),
        State("input-backend", "value"),
        State("input-timeout", "value"),
        State("chk-dry-run", "value"),
        State("input-batch-size", "value"),
        background=True,
        prevent_initial_call=True,
        running=[
            (Output("btn-process-all", "disabled"), True, False),
            (Output("btn-process-batch", "disabled"), True, False),
            (Output("btn-reprocess", "disabled"), True, False),
            (Output("btn-stop-all", "disabled"), False, True),
            (Output("btn-rescan", "disabled"), True, False),
        ],
    )
    def process_all_images(n_clicks, folder, recursive, host, port, model, backend, timeout, dry_run, batch_size):
        if not n_clicks or not folder:
            return dash.no_update

        limit = int(batch_size) if batch_size else 10
        if limit <= 0:
            limit = None

        logger.info("[Process All] received batch_size=%r, computed limit=%s", batch_size, limit)

        existing_state = read_batch_state(folder)
        if existing_state and existing_state.get("status") in ("running_all", "running"):
            return "A batch is already running for this folder."

        reset_shutdown_event()

        pc = _make_processing_config(host, port, model, backend, timeout, app_config.default_prompt, dry_run=bool(dry_run))
        strategy = _make_wal_strategy(folder, app_config)

        source_all = FolderImageSource(folder, recursive=bool(recursive), exclude_processed=False)
        total_all = source_all.total_pending()

        def run_batch(coord, coll, rep, batch_num, total_proc):
            return coord.run_folder_batch(
                folder,
                recursive=bool(recursive),
                limit=limit,
                saver=coll,
                reporter=rep,
            )

        return _run_batch_loop(
            folder, pc, strategy, limit, dry_run, "Process All",
            run_batch, total_all, final_action="processed",
        )

            return "A batch is already running for this folder."

        reset_shutdown_event()

        pc = _make_processing_config(host, port, model, backend, timeout, app_config.default_prompt, dry_run=bool(dry_run))
        strategy = _make_wal_strategy(folder, app_config)

        source_all = FolderImageSource(folder, recursive=bool(recursive), exclude_processed=False)
        all_paths = source_all.list_images(limit=None)
        total_all = len(all_paths)

        if total_all == 0:
            return "No images found in this folder."

        def run_batch(coord, coll, rep, batch_num, total_proc):
            chunk_size = limit or total_all
            chunk = all_paths[total_proc:total_proc + chunk_size]
            if not chunk:
                return BatchStats(total=0, success_count=0, failure_count=0,
                                  total_duration_ms=0.0, min_duration_ms=0.0,
                                  max_duration_ms=0.0, avg_duration_ms=0.0)
            return coord.run_paths_batch(
                chunk,
                saver=coll,
                reporter=rep,
            )

        return _run_batch_loop(
            folder, pc, strategy, limit, dry_run, "Reprocess All",
            run_batch, total_all, final_action="reprocessed",
        )

def register_polling_callback(app):
    @app.callback(
        Output("queue-status", "children"),
        Output("batch-progress-overall", "value"),
        Output("batch-progress-current", "value"),
        Output("batch-progress-current", "style"),
        Output("batch-progress-wrapper", "style"),
        Output("batch-progress-label", "children"),
        Output("batch-history", "children"),
        Output("batch-history-wrapper", "style"),
        Output("pending-count", "children"),
        Input("poll-interval", "n_intervals"),
        State("input-folder", "value"),
        State("chk-recursive", "value"),
        State("folder-cache", "data"),
        State("input-batch-size", "value"),
    )
    def poll_queue_status(_n_intervals, folder, recursive, cache_data, batch_size):
        _hidden = {"display": "none"}
        _visible = {"display": "block"}
        _no_label = ""
        limit = int(batch_size) if batch_size else 10
        if limit <= 0:
            limit = None

        def _pending_text(total_remaining, processed=0):
            if total_remaining <= 0:
                if processed > 0:
                    return f"{processed} processed"
                return ""
            pending = total_remaining if limit is None else min(total_remaining, limit)
            if processed > 0:
                return f"{pending} / {total_remaining} pending · {processed} processed"
            return f"{pending} / {total_remaining} pending"

        _folder_remaining = None

        def _get_folder_remaining():
            nonlocal _folder_remaining
            if _folder_remaining is None:
                try:
                    source = FolderImageSource(folder, recursive=bool(recursive), exclude_processed=True)
                    _folder_remaining = source.total_pending()
                except Exception:
                    _folder_remaining = 0
            return _folder_remaining

        _idle = (
            dbc.Badge("No folder set", color="secondary"),
            0, 0, _hidden, _hidden, _no_label,
            html.Div(), _hidden, "",
        )

        if not folder:
            return _idle

        try:
            state = read_batch_state(folder)
            if state:
                status = state.get("status")
                total = state.get("total", 0)
                completed = state.get("completed", 0)
                pct = int((completed / total) * 100) if total else 0
                batch_num = state.get("batch_num")
                batch_total = state.get("batch_total")
                batch_size_val = state.get("batch_size")
                batch_offset = state.get("batch_offset", 0)
                is_multi_batch = batch_total is not None and batch_total > 1

                microbatches = []
                try:
                    wal_path = Path(folder) / ".open-photo-agent" / "wal.jsonl"
                    if wal_path.exists():
                        wal_mtime = wal_path.stat().st_mtime
                        cached = _WAL_STATS_CACHE.get(folder, (None, None, 0))
                        wal_stats = cached[0]
                        wal_microbatches = cached[1]
                        wal_stats_ts = cached[2]
                        if wal_stats is None or wal_mtime != wal_stats_ts:
                            wal = WriteAheadLog(folder)
                            wal_stats = wal.get_stats()
                            wal_microbatches = wal.get_microbatch_summary(limit=5)
                            _WAL_STATS_CACHE[folder] = (wal_stats, wal_microbatches, wal_mtime)
                        microbatches = wal_microbatches
                except OSError:
                    pass

                if status in ("running", "running_all"):
                    if status == "running":
                        badge = dbc.Badge(
                            f"Processing — {completed}/{total}", color="warning"
                        )
                        pending_str = _pending_text(total - completed, completed)
                        label = f"{pct}% ({completed}/{total})"
                        return (
                            badge, pct, 0, _hidden, _visible,
                            label, html.Div(), _hidden, pending_str
                        )
                    else:
                        status_msg = state.get("status_msg", "")
                        batch_display = status_msg if status_msg else f"Processing All — {completed}/{total}"
                        badge = dbc.Badge(batch_display, color="info")
                        remaining = max(0, total - completed)
                        pending_str = _pending_text(remaining, completed)

                        if is_multi_batch:
                            current_batch_completed = completed - batch_offset
                            current_batch_total = min(batch_size_val or total, total - batch_offset) if batch_size_val else total
                            current_pct = int((current_batch_completed / current_batch_total) * 100) if current_batch_total else 0
                            label = f"Batch {batch_num} of {batch_total} — {pct}% ({completed}/{total})"
                            history = build_batch_history(microbatches)
                            history_wrapper = _visible if microbatches else _hidden
                            return (
                                badge, pct, current_pct, _visible, _visible,
                                label, history, history_wrapper, pending_str
                            )
                        else:
                            label = f"{pct}% ({completed}/{total})"
                            history = build_batch_history(microbatches)
                            history_wrapper = _visible if microbatches else _hidden
                            return (
                                badge, pct, 0, _hidden, _visible,
                                label, history, history_wrapper, pending_str
                            )

                if status == "done":
                    avg_ms = state.get("avg_duration_ms", 0)
                    total_s = state.get("total_model_time_s", 0)
                    cnt = state.get("completed", total)
                    if avg_ms and total_s:
                        badge = dbc.Badge(
                            f"Batch complete — {cnt} processed · avg {avg_ms:.0f} ms/photo · {total_s:.1f}s total",
                            color="success",
                        )
                    else:
                        badge = dbc.Badge(f"Batch complete — {cnt} processed", color="success")
                    return (
                        badge, 100, 0, _hidden, _visible,
                        "100%", html.Div(), _hidden,
                        _pending_text(_get_folder_remaining(), cnt)
                    )

                if status == "done_all":
                    avg_ms = state.get("avg_duration_ms", 0)
                    total_s = state.get("total_model_time_s", 0)
                    cnt = state.get("completed", total)
                    batch_total_done = batch_total or 1
                    label_done = f"Complete — {cnt} images processed in {batch_total_done} batch{'es' if batch_total_done > 1 else ''}"
                    if avg_ms and total_s:
                        badge = dbc.Badge(
                            f"{label_done} · avg {avg_ms:.0f} ms/photo · {total_s:.1f}s total",
                            color="success",
                        )
                    else:
                        badge = dbc.Badge(label_done, color="success")
                    history = build_batch_history(microbatches)
                    history_wrapper = _visible if microbatches else _hidden
                    return (
                        badge, 100, 0, _hidden, _visible,
                        label_done, history, history_wrapper,
                        _pending_text(0, cnt)
                    )

                if status == "aborted":
                    badge = dbc.Badge(
                        f"Aborted — {completed}/{total} processed", color="danger"
                    )
                    history = build_batch_history(microbatches)
                    history_wrapper = _visible if microbatches else _hidden
                    return (
                        badge, pct, 0, _hidden, _visible,
                        f"{pct}%", history, history_wrapper,
                        _pending_text(_get_folder_remaining(), completed)
                    )

            wal_stats = None
            wal_microbatches = []
            try:
                wal_path = Path(folder) / ".open-photo-agent" / "wal.jsonl"
                if wal_path.exists():
                    wal_mtime = wal_path.stat().st_mtime
                    cached = _WAL_STATS_CACHE.get(folder, (None, None, 0))
                    wal_stats = cached[0]
                    wal_stats_ts = cached[2]
                    if wal_stats is None or wal_mtime != wal_stats_ts:
                        wal = WriteAheadLog(folder)
                        wal_stats = wal.get_stats()
                        wal_microbatches = wal.get_microbatch_summary(limit=5)
                        _WAL_STATS_CACHE[folder] = (wal_stats, wal_microbatches, wal_mtime)
                    else:
                        wal_microbatches = cached[1]
            except OSError:
                pass
            if wal_stats and wal_stats.get("completed", 0) > 0:
                history = build_batch_history(wal_microbatches)
                history_wrapper = _visible if wal_microbatches else _hidden
                return (
                    dbc.Badge(
                        f"Idle — {wal_stats['completed']} processed, {wal_stats['pending']} pending",
                        color="secondary",
                    ),
                    0, 0, _hidden, _hidden, _no_label,
                    history, history_wrapper,
                    _pending_text(wal_stats.get("pending", 0), wal_stats.get("completed", 0))
                )

            cache_hit = (
                isinstance(cache_data, dict)
                and cache_data.get("folder") == folder
                and cache_data.get("recursive") == recursive
            )
            if cache_hit:
                total_all = cache_data.get("total_all", 0)
                total_remaining = cache_data.get("total_remaining", 0)
            else:
                source = FolderImageSource(folder, recursive=bool(recursive), exclude_processed=True)
                total_remaining = source.total_pending()
                total_all = source.total_all()

            if total_all == 0:
                return (
                    dbc.Badge("No images found in folder", color="secondary"),
                    0, 0, _hidden, _hidden, _no_label,
                    html.Div(), _hidden, ""
                )
            if total_remaining == 0:
                return (
                    dbc.Badge(f"Complete — {total_all} total", color="success"),
                    0, 0, _hidden, _hidden, _no_label,
                    html.Div(), _hidden, _pending_text(0, total_all)
                )
            processed = total_all - total_remaining
            return (
                dbc.Badge(f"Idle — {total_remaining} pending", color="secondary"),
                0, 0, _hidden, _hidden, _no_label,
                html.Div(), _hidden, _pending_text(total_remaining, processed)
            )
        except Exception:
            logger.warning("Failed to read folder status for %s", folder, exc_info=True)
            return (
                dbc.Badge("Error reading status", color="danger"),
                0, 0, _hidden, _hidden, _no_label,
                html.Div(), _hidden, ""
            )

import datetime
import os
from typing import List, Tuple
from urllib.parse import quote

import dash_bootstrap_components as dbc
from dash import html


def _preview_url(path: str, folder: str, size: str = "thumb") -> str:
    """Return a URL for the /preview server route."""
    return f"/preview?path={quote(path)}&folder={quote(folder)}&size={size}"


def build_tag_cloud(tags_with_counts: List[Tuple[str, int]], max_tags: int = 100, selected_tags: List[str] = None) -> html.Div:
    """Build a visual tag cloud with font sizes scaled by frequency.

    Args:
        tags_with_counts: List of (tag, count) tuples.
        max_tags: Maximum number of tags to render.
        selected_tags: Tags currently active in the chain (highlighted).

    Returns:
        A ``dash.html.Div`` containing styled tag buttons or an empty-state message.
    """
    if not tags_with_counts:
        return html.Div("No tags found.", className="text-muted")

    tags_with_counts = tags_with_counts[:max_tags]
    counts = [c for _, c in tags_with_counts]
    min_count = min(counts)
    max_count = max(counts)

    MIN_FONT = 12
    MAX_FONT = 32

    def _font_size(count: int) -> int:
        if max_count == min_count:
            return int((MIN_FONT + MAX_FONT) / 2)
        ratio = (count - min_count) / (max_count - min_count)
        return int(MIN_FONT + ratio * (MAX_FONT - MIN_FONT))

    selected_lower = {t.lower() for t in (selected_tags or [])}
    buttons = []
    for tag, count in tags_with_counts:
        font_size = _font_size(count)
        is_selected = tag.lower() in selected_lower
        color = "primary" if is_selected else "light"
        buttons.append(
            dbc.Button(
                f"{tag} ({count})",
                id={"type": "tag-cloud-btn", "index": tag},
                color=color,
                size="sm",
                className="me-1 mb-1",
                style={"fontSize": f"{font_size}px"},
            )
        )

    return html.Div(buttons, className="d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center")


def build_selected_tags_bar(selected_tags: List[str]) -> html.Div:
    """Build a row of removable pill badges for the active tag chain.

    Args:
        selected_tags: Currently selected tag strings.

    Returns:
        A ``dash.html.Div`` with pill badges and small × remove buttons.
    """
    if not selected_tags:
        return html.Div()

    badges = []
    for tag in selected_tags:
        badges.append(
            html.Div(
                [
                    dbc.Badge(
                        tag,
                        color="primary",
                        pill=True,
                        className="me-1",
                    ),
                    dbc.Button(
                        "×",
                        id={"type": "tag-clear-btn", "index": tag},
                        color="link",
                        size="sm",
                        className="p-0 me-3",
                        style={"lineHeight": "1", "fontSize": "14px"},
                    ),
                ],
                className="d-inline-flex align-items-center",
            )
        )

    return html.Div(
        [
            html.Small("Active filters:", className="text-muted me-2"),
            *badges,
        ],
        className="d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center mb-2",
    )


def build_batch_history(microbatches):
    """Build a Dash component list for micro-batch history.

    Args:
        microbatches: List of dicts with keys ``microbatch_id``, ``total``,
            ``completed``, ``failed``, ``pending``.

    Returns:
        A ``dash.html.Div`` containing the history UI.
    """
    if not microbatches:
        return html.Div("No batch history available.", className="text-muted small")

    items = []
    for mb in microbatches:
        mb_id = mb.get("microbatch_id", "unknown")
        total = mb.get("total", 0)
        completed = mb.get("completed", 0)
        failed = mb.get("failed", 0)
        pending = mb.get("pending", 0)
        pct = int((completed / total) * 100) if total else 0

        if pending > 0:
            status_color = "warning"
        elif failed > 0:
            status_color = "danger"
        else:
            status_color = "success"

        items.append(
            html.Div(
                [
                    html.Strong(mb_id, className="me-2 small text-monospace"),
                    dbc.Badge(
                        f"{completed}/{total}",
                        color=status_color,
                        className="me-1",
                    ),
                    html.Small(
                        f"{pct}% · {failed} failed, {pending} pending",
                        className="text-muted",
                    ),
                ],
                className="mb-1",
            )
        )

    return html.Div(
        [
            html.H6("Recent batches", className="small mt-2 mb-1 text-muted"),
            html.Div(items),
        ]
    )

    Args:

    count_label = f"{len(items)}"

                            className="w-100",
                            disabled=True,

        ]

def build_detail_modal_content(image_path, folder, metadata, embedding=None, embedding_error=None):
    """Build the content for the detail modal.

    Args:
        image_path: Absolute path to the image.
        folder: Current folder scope.
        metadata: Dict from ``FeaturesDatabase.get_feature_summary`` or None.
        embedding: Optional list of floats representing the embedding vector.
        embedding_error: Optional error message if embedding couldn't be loaded.

    Returns:
        A ``dash.html.Div`` with a large preview and metadata read-out.
    """
    preview_url = _preview_url(image_path, folder, size="full") if folder else ""
    img = html.Img(
        src=preview_url,
        style={"maxWidth": "100%", "maxHeight": "70vh", "objectFit": "contain", "userSelect": "none"},
        className="img-fluid mb-3 d-block mx-auto",
        draggable="false",
    )

    if not metadata:
        meta = html.Div("Not yet processed", className="text-muted")
    else:
        rows = []
        for key in ("description", "subjects", "objects", "colors", "setting", "mood"):
            val = metadata.get(key)
            if val:
                rows.append(html.P([html.Strong(f"{key.capitalize()}: "), str(val)], className="mb-1"))
        tags = metadata.get("tags")
        if tags:
            rows.append(
                html.P([html.Strong("Tags: "), ", ".join(str(t) for t in tags)], className="mb-1")
            )
        meta = html.Div(rows)

    # Build embedding display
    embedding_display = html.Div()
    if embedding_error:
        embedding_display = html.Div(
            [
                html.Strong("Embedding: "),
                html.Span(
                    f"Error: {embedding_error}",
                    className="text-danger",
                ),
            ],
            className="mb-1",
        )
    elif embedding is not None and len(embedding) > 0:
        # Format embedding preview (show first 10 values)
        embedding_preview = ", ".join(f"{v:.4f}" for v in embedding[:10])
        if len(embedding) > 10:
            embedding_preview += f", ... ({len(embedding)} total)"
        embedding_display = html.Div(
            [
                html.Strong("Embedding: "),
                html.Span(
                    embedding_preview,
                    className="selectable-text",
                    style={"userSelect": "text", "cursor": "text"},
                ),
            ],
            className="mb-1",
        )
    else:
        # Show warning if embeddings are not available
        # Check if metadata has embedding_error
        embedding_warning = "Not available"
        if metadata and isinstance(metadata, dict):
            model_output = metadata.get("model_output")
            if isinstance(model_output, dict) and model_output.get("embedding_error"):
                embedding_warning = f"Generation failed: {model_output['embedding_error'][:100]}"
            elif isinstance(model_output, str):
                # model_output might be a JSON string
                import json
                try:
                    parsed = json.loads(model_output)
                    if isinstance(parsed, dict) and parsed.get("embedding_error"):
                        embedding_warning = f"Generation failed: {parsed['embedding_error'][:100]}"
                except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
                    pass
        
        # If no specific error but image was processed successfully, provide guidance
        if embedding_warning == "Not available" and metadata and isinstance(metadata, dict):
            success = metadata.get("success", False)
            if success:
                embedding_warning = "Not generated - check Ollama server and embedding model"
        
        embedding_display = html.Div(
            [
                html.Strong("Embedding: "),
                html.Span(
                    embedding_warning,
                    className="text-warning",
                ),
            ],
            className="mb-1",
        )

    return html.Div(
        [
            img,
            html.Hr(),
            meta,
            html.Div(
                [
                    dbc.Button(
                        "Find Similar",
                        id="btn-find-similar",
                        color="primary",
                        size="sm",
                        className="me-2 mt-2",
                    ),

import tempfile
import unittest

import dash
import dash_bootstrap_components as dbc
from dash import html

from src.callbacks.search import register_search_callback
from src.sidecar.database import FeaturesDatabase
from tests.test_callbacks import find_callback


class TestSearchCallback(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.app = dash.Dash(__name__, external_stylesheets=[dbc.themes.BOOTSTRAP])
        self.app.layout = html.Div(
            [
                html.Div(id="search-results"),
                html.Div(id="search-status"),
                html.Div(id="photo-list-store"),
                html.Div(id="btn-search"),
                html.Div(id="search-input"),
                html.Div(id="input-folder"),
            ]
        )
        register_search_callback(self.app)

    def test_no_click_returns_no_update(self):
        cb = find_callback(self.app, "search-results", "children").__wrapped__
        result = cb(None, "", "")
        self.assertEqual(result, (dash.no_update, dash.no_update, dash.no_update))

    def test_no_folder_returns_warning(self):
        cb = find_callback(self.app, "search-results", "children").__wrapped__
        results, status, store = cb(1, "", "")
        self.assertEqual(results, dash.no_update)
        self.assertIn("Enter a folder", str(status))
        self.assertEqual(store, dash.no_update)

    def test_no_db_returns_warning(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            cb = find_callback(self.app, "search-results", "children").__wrapped__
            results, status, store = cb(1, "", td)
            self.assertEqual(results, dash.no_update)
            self.assertIn("No features.db", str(status))
            self.assertEqual(store, dash.no_update)

    def test_empty_query_returns_warning(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            db = FeaturesDatabase(FeaturesDatabase.default_db_path(td))
            db.init_db()
            cb = find_callback(self.app, "search-results", "children").__wrapped__
            results, status, store = cb(1, "", td)
            self.assertEqual(results, dash.no_update)
            self.assertIn("Enter a search", str(status))
            self.assertEqual(store, dash.no_update)

    def test_no_results_returns_message(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            db = FeaturesDatabase(FeaturesDatabase.default_db_path(td))
            db.save_extraction(
                "/fake/img.jpg",
                {
                    "success": True,
                    "model": "test",
                    "response": "{}",
                    "parsed": {"description": "hello world", "subjects": "", "tags": ["tag1"]},
                },
            )
            db.rebuild_fts_index()
            cb = find_callback(self.app, "search-results", "children").__wrapped__
            results, status, store = cb(1, "nonexistent", td)
            self.assertIn("No results", str(results))
            self.assertEqual(status, dash.no_update)
            self.assertEqual(store, dash.no_update)

            self.assertIsInstance(store, dict)
            self.assertEqual(store["paths"], ["/fake/img.jpg"])
